  SELECT
    tc.geoid AS geoid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tc.source = 'm1_city' AND tc.grp = 'all' THEN CAST(tc.n AS DOUBLE) END) AS req_311,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tc.source = 'm2_city' AND tc.grp = 'all' THEN CAST(tc.n AS DOUBLE) END) AS n_viol
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts tc
  WHERE tc.run_id = 'r_20261024_ee364c'
    AND tc.source IN ('m1_city','m2_city')
    AND tc.grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY tc.geoid
),
paired AS (
  SELECT
    t.name AS tract_name,
    b.req_311 AS req_311_count,
    b.n_viol AS n_violations,
    (b.req_311 * 1000.0 / t.totalpopulation) AS req_311_per_1000_residents,
    (b.n_viol * 1000.0 / t.totalpopulation) AS violations_per_1000_residents,
    t.totalpopulation AS population

  LEFT JOIN base b ON b.geoid = t.geoid
  WHERE t.geoid IS NOT NULL
    AND b.req_311 IS NOT NULL
    AND b.n_viol IS NOT NULL
    AND t.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL

)
SELECT
  tract_name,
  req_311_per_1000_residents,
  violations_per_1000_residents,
  req_311_count,
  n_violations,
  population,
  CORR(req_311_per_1000_residents, violations_per_1000_residents) OVER () AS corr_311_violations_per_1000_residents,

FROM paired

WITH req AS (
  SELECT geoid AS geoid, SUM(CAST(n AS DOUBLE)) AS req_311_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_ee364c' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
viol AS (
  SELECT geoid AS geoid, SUM(CAST(n AS DOUBLE)) AS n_violations
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_ee364c' AND source = 'm2_city' AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
paired AS (
  SELECT
    t.name AS tract_name,
    COALESCE(r.req_311_count, 0) AS req_311_count,
    COALESCE(v.n_violations, 0) AS n_violations,
    (COALESCE(r.req_311_count, 0) * 1000.0) AS req_311_per_1000_residents,
    (COALESCE(v.n_violations, 0) * 1000.0) AS violations_per_1000_residents,
    t.geoid AS geoid
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN req r ON r.geoid = t.geoid
  LEFT JOIN viol v ON v.geoid = t.geoid
  WHERE t.geoid IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  tract_name,
  req_311_per_1000_residents,
  violations_per_1000_residents,
  req_311_count,
  n_violations,
  geoid,
  CORR(req_311_per_1000_residents, violations_per_1000_residents) OVER () AS corr_311_violations_per_1000_residents,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts
FROM paired
ORDER BY req_311_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200
